text:
maria_se: Quick status check on SentryBridge POC — need to confirm owners for integration deliverables and cutover milestones. Main question: who owns the staging network firewall rule and who will validate end-to-end?

jamal_sales: We're aiming for go/no-go on Tue 2026-03-11. SE success criteria doc: https://redwood.work/sb-poc-criteria :eyes: Can we lock owners today?

rachel_eng: I can own the E2E validation tests. Will add test cases to the repo under tests/poc/sentrybridge and open a PR by EOD tomorrow.

kumar_platform: Kumar here — I'll take the firewall/network rule. Need the VPC CIDR and exact ports to open. @li_devops can you confirm the infra details?

li_devops: Confirming CIDR 10.12.0.0/16. Open ports for the POC: 443, 80, 10250 (kube). I'm doing the terraform change now. Plan to push the branch and PR by 1767774670. Snippet of the tf change:```hcl
resource "aws_security_group_rule" "sentrybridge_https" {
  type        = "ingress"
  from_port   = 443
  to_port     = 443
  protocol    = "tcp"
  cidr_blocks = ["10.12.0.0/16"]
}
```

maria_se: Thanks. Note: Dedicated routing for the POC will route to model variant "small-v2". Rachel, please add a validation that the client falls back to "small-v1" when small-v2 is unavailable.

rachel_eng: Will add fallback test. Also please ping @deploy-bot for a canary deploy window so we can validate after infra changes.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary deploy for 2026-03-11T02:00Z -> 2026-03-11T03:00Z. :white_check_mark:

maria_se: Next blocker: TLS cert for api.redwood-sentrybridge.internal — @kumar_platform can you confirm cert request?

kumar_platform: I'll request cert from cert-ops now, expect turnaround ~24h. If delayed we'll use a temporary self-signed cert and add exception on the client.

jamal_sales: Sales needs the demo script with exact success criteria and telemetry expectations: p50 latency < 200ms, sustained 20 req/s. @maria_se can you confirm those numbers?

maria_se: Confirmed on latency and throughput. We'll capture traces on route /poc/sentrybridge and share a dashboard link after canary.

li_devops: Terraform PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/987 — ready for review. @rachel_eng please sanity-check connectivity after merge.

rachel_eng: Reviewing now, left one minor comment on healthcheck path. Once that's resolved I'll run the E2E.

maria_se: Summary: owners — network: kumar_platform, e2e: rachel_eng, infra PR: li_devops, sales: jamal_sales. Cutover target and demo on 2026-03-11. If no blockers we roll canary then run E2E. Next sync in 24h unless anything urgent. :thumbsup:
